preconditions.name: enough_divergent_seeds
preconditions.description: the number of seeds whose candidate pool is DIVERGENT on ALL C1 comparison arms (A0 + A1 + A2 + ARM_NOISE) is >= MIN_DIVERGENT_SEEDS. Per-seed-divergent gating: a degenerate cell self-excludes. Too few divergent seeds => substrate_not_ready_requeue (pool too collapsed to test conversion).
preconditions.control: consumed cand_world_summary pairwise spread > floor (GAP-A); per-seed

preconditions.name: finer_channels_dissociable
preconditions.description: MECH-451 NON-DEGENERACY gate (1): the A2 finer w_chan_finer entries MOVED from the softplus-unity init AND carry cross-channel RANGE above floor on a strict-majority of seeds -- finer entries that move IDENTICALLY (range ~0) are the compressed blend re-labelled, NOT a genuine decomposition. Below floor => substrate_not_ready_requeue.
preconditions.control: A2 fcg_w_chan_finer_range_max vs floor (softplus-unity init => range 0)

preconditions.name: finer_channels_dissociation_substantive
preconditions.description: 704b NEAR-VACUITY GUARD (autopsy Step 7): the A2 LEARNED finer-channel range must be SUBSTANTIVE -- clear W_CHAN_FINER_SUBSTANTIVE_RANGE_FLOOR (well above the bare dissociability floor AND above V3-EXQ-704's near-vacuous 0.00148) on a strict-majority of seeds. A dissociation only barely above the floor is 'the compressed blend re-labelled'; a strict-above bar against an equally-tiny matched null is a knife-edge non-test. measured = median A2 learned range. Below floor => substrate_not_ready_requeue (NEVER a misleading no-lift weakens).
preconditions.control: median A2 fcg_w_chan_finer_range_max vs SUBSTANTIVE floor

preconditions.name: delta_t_carries_variance_on_armed_arms
preconditions.description: the signed-RPE delta_t (= benefit_eval - harm_eval - V-hat_t) carries cross-tick STD above floor on a majority of seeds on the A2 finer arm AND the A1 global-w_chan arm -- there is outcome variance to learn from. Flat => substrate_not_ready_requeue.
preconditions.control: fcg_delta_t_std (A2) + lcg_delta_t_std (A1) on the armed arms

preconditions.name: learned_weights_moved_from_init_on_armed_arms
preconditions.description: A2 finer w_chan_finer range > floor (softplus-unity init => range 0) AND A1 global w_chan range > floor (the load-bearing collapse-to-blend ablation must itself be a real learner). Weights never moving => eligibility never credited => substrate_not_ready_requeue.

preconditions.name: matched_noise_control_verified_lifting
preconditions.description: the SAME-LAYER finer-gating null (ARM_NOISE: frozen magnitude-matched random w_chan_finer with eta=0) lifts committed-class entropy strict-above A0 by margin on a strict-majority of DIVERGENT seeds. A null that does NOT verify-lift makes the strict-above bar meaningless (the 569g/700b lesson). Control not verify-lifting => substrate_not_ready_requeue (704b matches the null to the realised A2 range at the correct layer).
preconditions.control: ARM_NOISE committed-class entropy vs A0, divergent seeds, paired

preconditions.name: fcg_noise_magnitude_matched
preconditions.description: ARM_NOISE's median frozen-random w_chan_finer range is within [FCG_NOISE_MAGNITUDE_MATCH_LO, FCG_NOISE_MAGNITUDE_MATCH_HI] x the median A2 LEARNED w_chan_finer range -- so the random null is magnitude-matched to the structure A2 learns at the SAME layer. measured = the ratio. 704b matches the injected range to the REALISED per-seed A2 learned range at RUN TIME (target 1.0x), so this lands in-band by construction; an out-of-band ratio (degenerate / fallback path) => substrate_not_ready_requeue.
preconditions.control: median ARM_NOISE fcg_w_chan_finer_range_max vs median A2 learned range

preconditions.name: candidate_pool_divergent_focus_arms
preconditions.description: consumed cand_world_summaries (e2.world_forward) per-candidate SPREAD clears the floor on a majority of seeds in the focus arms (GAP-A non-vacuity). This is the per-seed divergence the gating reads.
preconditions.control: SD-056 e2 trained online in P0; candidate_summary_source=e2_world_forward
